reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_crd_identities`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: After the upgrade the metric is exposed as doublewrite_crd_identities instead of doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count, so monitoring queries that use the old name no longer match it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use doublewrite_crd_identities.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count is renamed to doublewrite_crd_identities, so anything that queries the old name needs updating.
